summary: Frontend testing of FitJourney 2.0 admin/nutritionist flows. All primary fixes verified as working. One minor design issue found (duplicate Configurações in sidebar for admin).

ui_bugs.issue: 'Configurações' link appears TWICE in sidebar for admin users: once from adminLinks array (line 78 in DashboardLayout.tsx) and once from the static bottom section in SidebarContent (lines 157-163)

issues: Configurações item appears twice: once in the nav link list and once in the bottom section of the sidebar. This makes the sidebar look cluttered and confuses navigation.

Landing page main content area appears mostly dark/empty on initial load (the hero section content is not visible in above-the-fold area, only the navbar and bottom text). This may be a rendering or animation timing issue.

action_items: MINOR: Fix duplicate 'Configurações' in admin sidebar. Remove it from either adminLinks array (DashboardLayout.tsx line 78) OR conditionally hide the static Settings link in SidebarContent bottom section when user is admin (since it's already in the nav list).
MINOR: Check landing page hero section rendering - appears dark/empty above the fold, possibly missing hero content or animation not triggering correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardLayout.tsx line 78: adminLinks includes '/settings' as 'Configurações', but SidebarContent (lines 157-163) also hardcodes a static '/settings' link at bottom for all roles. For admin, this creates a duplicate. Suggest: conditionally render bottom Settings link only when the link is NOT already in the links array, or remove it from adminLinks.

auth.tsx line 112: `isAdmin: (roles as string[]).includes('admin')` - uses type cast to string[] because app_role enum may not include 'admin'. This is a workaround. Consider adding 'admin' to the app_role enum in Supabase types.

Index.tsx: NutritionistDashboardContent fetches patient data one by one in a for loop (line 343 `for (const pid of patientIds.slice(0, 30))`), making multiple sequential Supabase calls. With 30 patients this could be very slow. Consider batching these calls.
seed_data_creation: None - tested with existing user data (no patients registered yet)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary bug fixes from the review_request are working correctly: (1) clinical modules (Protocolos, Programas, Receitas etc) are present in admin sidebar, (2) no refresh loop after login, (3) Dashboard Clínico shows for admin users, (4) no duplicate Automação in sidebar. Only minor issue: duplicate Configurações in sidebar for admin. Landing page tested as showing correctly for unauthenticated users. Navigation to /protocols, /programs, /recipes, /food-database all work without redirects.

duplicate_configuracoes.issue: Configurações appears twice in admin sidebar
duplicate_configuracoes.root_cause: DashboardLayout.tsx adminLinks array (line 78) includes {to: '/settings', label: 'Configurações'}. Additionally, SidebarContent component (lines 157-163) has a static hardcoded Settings link in the bottom section that renders for ALL user roles. When admin logs in, adminLinks are used for the main nav list AND the static bottom section also renders Configurações.
duplicate_configuracoes.fix: Either: (1) Remove {to: '/settings'} from adminLinks array, or (2) Conditionally hide the static bottom Settings link when it's already in the current links array by checking `!links.some(l => l.to === '/settings')`
